diagrams.title: Process Execution Lifecycle
diagrams.content:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  Shell->>Kernel: Spawn Child Process
  Note over Kernel: Allocate resources and load binary
  Kernel-->>Shell: Return Process Handle
  Shell->>Kernel: Wait for Completion
  Note over Kernel,Child: Child runs task
  Child-->>Kernel: Exit with Status
  Kernel-->>Shell: Unblock and Return Status
